scientific_limitations: Exact only for symmetric nonnegative stochastic matrices on complete split graphs with both vertex classes of size at least two and uniform stationary law; full optimizer face is described by a spectral constraint, not an entrywise list. Prior literature already implies the optimal scalar rate. Unindexed optimizer-face coverage remains possible.
title: Every fastest-mixing kernel on complete split graphs
